```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# SHARED FIGURE SETUP, pulled in with {{< include ../../_figure-setup.qmd >}}.
#
# Lecture 2's copy of this block said that a THIRD page carrying figures was
# the trigger to stop copying it; lecture 7 was the fourth, so this is that
# include. Lectures 2, 3 and the landing page still carry their own copies and
# were deliberately not migrated -- they are finished, published pages. When
# one of them is next edited for another reason, switch it to this file.
#
# The leading underscore keeps Quarto from rendering this as a page. It holds
# ONLY what every figure page shares: fonts, palette, rcParams. Anything
# lecture-specific (r_isco, gamma, ...) belongs in the lecture.

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import matplotlib as mpl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.font_manager as fm

_FONTDIR = next(
    (p / "fonts" for p in (Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents) if (p / "fonts").is_dir()),
    None,
)
if _FONTDIR is None:
    raise RuntimeError(f"no fonts/ directory found above {Path.cwd()}")
for _f in sorted(_FONTDIR.glob("*.otf")):
    fm.fontManager.addfont(str(_f))

# Assert rather than hope: matplotlib does not raise on a missing family, it
# silently substitutes DejaVu Sans and the build "succeeds" with every figure
# quietly wrong.
_got = Path(fm.findfont(fm.FontProperties(family="XCharter"))).name
assert _got.startswith("XCharter"), (
    f"XCharter did not resolve (matplotlib chose {_got!r}). "
    f"Checked {_FONTDIR}. Figures would silently fall back to DejaVu Sans."
)

# Validated 3-slot categorical palette (all-pairs safe, light surface).
BLUE, ORANGE, AQUA = "#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a"
INK, INK2, MUTED = "#0b0b0b", "#52514e", "#898781"
GRID, AXIS, SURFACE = "#e1e0d9", "#c3c2b7", "#fcfcfb"

mpl.rcParams.update({
    "figure.facecolor": SURFACE,
    "axes.facecolor": SURFACE,
    "savefig.facecolor": SURFACE,
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["XCharter"],
    # "stix" is the closest available neighbor to the page's mathjax-termes.
    # It is NOT mathjax-stix2 -- see the note in the special-relativity setup
    # cell. If the page's MathJax font changes, revisit this.
    "mathtext.fontset": "stix",
    "font.size": 11,
    "axes.edgecolor": AXIS,
    "axes.linewidth": 0.8,
    "axes.labelcolor": INK2,
    "axes.titlecolor": INK,
    "axes.titlesize": 12,
    "axes.grid": True,
    "grid.color": GRID,
    "grid.linewidth": 0.8,
    "grid.linestyle": "-",
    "xtick.color": MUTED,
    "ytick.color": MUTED,
    "xtick.labelcolor": INK2,
    "ytick.labelcolor": INK2,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "legend.frameon": False,
    "lines.linewidth": 2.0,
    "lines.markersize": 8,
})
```
